title: Blueprint Preparation & Value Hypothesis
body: Entry prerequisites, building the value hypothesis and PBOs, pressure-testing sponsorship, customer pre-work, and session readiness checks
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Build a value hypothesis (Why Change, Why Now, Why Glean) tied to strategic priorities.
Write PBOs and a 3-5 metric hypothesis per line of business.
Run the prerequisites checklist and decide go / reschedule.
Send pre-work and agenda that set a consultative tone.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-103. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
